# neyvia

## agent-guide
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- Agent guide: chats, apps, windows and every exact action
F The exact contract directory includes every registered native action. Runtime, provider, desktop and MCP-scope readiness must still be observed; no listed action claims a completed journey.
M neyvia "Begin with a specific goal. Read this guide, then load only the owning manual chapter. Use CL help at L1, run named procedures, keep refs/stamps host managed, and finish with a fresh observer G." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Chats: session.new starts a CLI or native chat; session rename/pin/move/archive change the same user-visible state. Read agents and runtime-provider for provider turns, limits and recovery." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Apps: app.open opens a real app or pane; read its app manual. Window ids come from view.state. view.place uses main (beside chat), side (left/right), full, bubble or close without remounting." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Browser: browser opens, observes and acts on owned tabs. CAPTCHA/bot checks stop automation for the owner; never solve or bypass. Owner resumes after a fresh page check." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Computer use and agent view: computer-use grants scoped native control on the agent desktop; agent-view observes, steers and replays recorded work. Owner consent remains required." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "LAYA: efficiency.laya_verify and cua.verify inspect evidence with the local verifier. Its answer is advisory; an unavailable model never becomes a made-up approval." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Images: image-studio covers provider generation with explicit requests, local pixel edits, protected regions and exports. Inspect the live preview and generation receipt; provider availability is separate." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "App Factory: app-sdk creates/builds/inspects applications and frames; preview observes running apps. Native toolchains and permission checks apply." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "3D Studio and connectors: gamedev and game-dev expose editor sessions, actual bridge actions and asset validation. Installed Unity/Roblox/Godot/Blender connectors must report availability before use." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Dictation: dictation covers status, local streaming transcription and named text processing. It uses the shared engine and reports fallback/availability honestly." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Files, notes and PDF: files uses scoped paths, recoverable trash and undo; notes reads/writes the same notes folder; pdf opens/searches/annotates and extracts actual document text." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Terminal and research: workspace covers bounded reads/writes and permitted terminal execution. research uses provider-backed cited answers and receipts. External actions never gain authority from this manual." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Look and placement are reversible user choices. Keep chat drafts, source files and existing app instances while changing the view." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## apps
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- apps
T t1{projects:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" sessions:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" apps:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" running:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" providerSessionsObserved:bool ..}
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.state()
A neyvia.state() -> t1 -- Read project/pane/density/projects/session overlays/apps; provider runs available only with attached backend
F verify-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.state
P locate-app-state():apps=neyvia.state(); J app-state -- Read shared app state before loading its specific manual
V P locate-app-state -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J app-state use-app-manual|await-user-side:"Is the app state current enough to act?" -- App state must contain supported observer data; requests are not rendered observations. Choose app manual by actual goal.
V J app-state -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X App absent/null in state.apps -> Open through app-specific tool and await app report; no invented selection
F No universal app-launch tool in this chapter
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## modding-neyvia
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- Building apps and mods
M neyvia "Start from templates/neyvia-module. Copy the template to apps/<module-id>, choose a unique id and the neyvia.mod.<namespace>.<action> namespace, and list every owned file." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Implement the declared function(args, root=...) in the owned Python file. Declare the exact input schema and actual read/artifact_write/external_action mutability; no core action overrides." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Write manuals/cl/<module-id>.cl with typed actions, executable checks and procedures, using hello-module.cl as the small example. Add its CL source/artifact to config/neyvia_manuals.json." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Run system Python scripts/cl_compile_manuals.py, then scripts/generate_module_map.py. The compiler's --check includes map ownership, missing-action and entry-point navigation checks." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Read docs/BUILDING_APPS_AND_MODS.md and use neyvia-sdk for provider sign-in, model calls, memory, LAYA verification, CL/manual calls and app hosting. Never implement parallel provider credentials or memory stores for shared services." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Restart only your owned local backend to discover new action schemas. Install the app or mod through the existing marketplace from its local folder or git URL; inspect its manual and contracts. Run the manual contract; switch off/on and prove refusal/persistence." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Commit source, authored CL, compiled artifacts and the generated registry together. Never push, merge, publish or install an untrusted mod through this path." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Executable entry points: modules.verify-map(), modules.set-optional(id='hello-module',enabled=false), hello-module.verify-greeting()." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## overview
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- Sidebar, projects, sessions, scheduling, runtime and missions
T t1{projects:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" sessions:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" apps:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" running:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" providerSessionsObserved:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.state()
A neyvia.state() -> t1 -- Read project/pane/density/projects/session overlays/apps; provider runs available only with attached backend
F verify-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.state
A neyvia.manual.index() -> t2 -- Read manual descriptions and chapter names; no action execution
F verify-manual-index "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.manual.index" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.manual.index
P choose-manual():workspace=neyvia.state(); index=neyvia.manual.index(); J manual-selection -- Read workspace and available chapters before selecting mapped environment
V P choose-manual -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J manual-selection load-mapped|frontier:"Which manual/chapter covers the requested operation?" -- Match actual app/goal to manual.index; load relevant chapter only. Requested app state is not observed rendering; a manual never widens authority.
V J manual-selection -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X state.running empty without backend -> Check providerSessionsObserved; overlay is not provider inventory
F Unlisted app goals need bounded exploration and quarantined patches
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified

L neyvia v1 -- panes
T t1{projects:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" sessions:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" apps:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" running:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" providerSessionsObserved:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"diff\",\"file\",\"artifact\",\"terminal\",\"browser\",\"mission\",\"replay\",\"builder\",\"accounts\",\"runtime\",\"settings\",\"preview\",\"outputs\",\"perception\"]}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t4 [json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"sidebar\",\"main\",\"panel\",\"canopy\"]}"]
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"left\",\"right\"]}"
T t6 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"auto\",\"on\",\"off\"]}"
T t7 [{id:json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"continue\",\"needs\",\"running\",\"nightshift\",\"projects\",\"usage\"]}" size?:json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"s\",\"m\",\"l\"]}" ..}]
T t8{terminals:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" ..}
T t9{text:str alive:bool ..}
T t10 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"main\",\"side\",\"full\",\"bubble\",\"close\"]}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.state()
A neyvia.state() -> t1 -- Read project/pane/density/projects/session overlays/apps; provider runs available only with attached backend
F verify-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.state
A neyvia.pane.show(kind:t2 target:str) -> t3 ! -- Persist requested pane and emit pane.show; the UI opens file (view/edit/diff, folder list), artifact (sandboxed HTML, Markdown, image, PDF), terminal (folder, or a command typed but never run) or runtime; target existence not validated
C neyvia.pane.show pane-kind:neyvia.state() .pane.kind == kind
C neyvia.pane.show terminal-pane:neyvia.state() .pane.kind == "terminal"
A neyvia.view.arrange(order?:t4 dock?:t5 canopy?:t6 sidebarHidden?:bool widgets?:t7) -> t3 -- Merge arrangement fields; omitted fields retained; emit UI request
F verify-view-arrange "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.arrange" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.arrange
A neyvia.view.float(id:str floating?:bool) -> t3 ! -- Persist floating flag and emit chat-bubble request
F verify-view-float "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.float" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.float
A neyvia.terminal.list() -> t8 -- Read terminal ids, folders, shells, alive flag and last output time
F verify-terminal-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.terminal.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.terminal.list
A neyvia.terminal.read(id:str chars?:int) -> t9 -- Read the last chars (default 4000) of plain output, colours removed; never types
F verify-terminal-read "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.terminal.read" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.terminal.read
A neyvia.view.place(id:str placement:t10 side?:t5) -> t3 ! -- Move or close the existing app/pane window through the placement model. CL verifies the delivered event and actual mounted placement before completion.
C neyvia.view.place shell-mounted:neyvia.view.state() .state.dom.mounted == true
A neyvia.view.state() -> t3 -- Read current windows, ids, placements, mounted DOM geometry and delivered events.
F verify-window-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.state
C neyvia.state pane-kind:neyvia.state() .pane.kind == kind
C neyvia.state terminal-pane:neyvia.state() .pane.kind == "terminal"
C neyvia.view.state shell-mounted:neyvia.view.state() .state.dom.mounted == true
P show-work-artifact(kind:t2 target:str):before=neyvia.state(); J pane-target=show; requested=neyvia.pane.show(kind:kind target:target) C pane-kind -- Choose pane for inspected artifact and verify requested pane kind
V P show-work-artifact -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P suggest-command(command:str):J command-safe=suggest; requested=neyvia.pane.show(kind:"terminal" target:command) C terminal-pane; terminals=neyvia.terminal.list() -- Put a command in Paul's terminal for him to run, then read what it printed
V P suggest-command -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P place-window(id:str placement:t10):placed=neyvia.view.place(id:id placement:placement) C shell-mounted -- Place an existing window and verify the actual rendered effect; unknown or stale windows refuse before dispatch.
V P place-window -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P place-right-panel(id:str):placed=neyvia.view.place(id:id placement:"side" side:"right") C shell-mounted -- Place an existing window in the right side pane and witness its mounted effect.
V P place-right-panel -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J pane-target show|leave:"Which pane makes this artifact useful?" -- Choose schema kind; target existence is not checked by pane.show. Inspect file/artifact first; preserve current workspace context.
V J pane-target -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
J command-safe suggest|leave:"Is this a command Paul should run himself in his terminal?" -- The command is typed on the prompt line, never run; Paul presses Enter. Read the result later with terminal.read on the id from terminal.list.
V J command-safe -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X Pane request succeeds but target missing -> Stat/read target and inspect app; check proves requested kind only
X Arrangement repeats region/unknown widget -> Use unique known regions and advertised widget IDs
X Suggested command shows no output -> It is typed, not run: ask Paul to press Enter, then terminal.read
X HTML artifact cannot call Neyvia or read cookies -> By design: artifacts run sandboxed; files next to the HTML load, Neyvia's API does not
X File pane save refused (changed on disk) -> Paul chooses: load the new version or save his over it; never retry silently
F Rendered resize/floating geometry needs UI observation
F Models cannot type into or run commands in Paul's terminals; use their own shell tools
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py, neyvia_panes.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified

L neyvia v1 -- projects
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"empty\",\"git\"]}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.folder.list()
A neyvia.folder.list() -> t1 -- Read registered project folders; no filesystem discovery
F verify-folder-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.folder.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.folder.list
A neyvia.folder.create(path:str name:str git?:bool) -> t1 ! -- Create target directory, optionally git init, register project and emit project.created
F verify-folder-create "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.folder.create" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.folder.create
A neyvia.folder.open(path:str) -> t1 ! -- Persist activeProject and emit file pane for directory
C neyvia.folder.open active-folder:neyvia.state() .project == path
A neyvia.project.create(name:str path?:str template?:t2) -> t1 ! -- Create/register target, optionally git template; existing folder contents preserved
F verify-project-create "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.project.create" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.project.create
C neyvia.state active-folder:neyvia.state() .project == path
P open-project-folder(path:str):registered=neyvia.folder.list(); J project-folder=open; opened=neyvia.folder.open(path:path) C active-folder -- Read registrations, confirm existing project folder and open
V P open-project-folder -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P create-folder(name:str path:str):created=neyvia.folder.create(name:name path:path) -- Create the selected local folder and register it after owner approval
V P create-folder -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P create-default-project(name:str):created=neyvia.project.create(name:name) -- Create and register a named local project in the default projects folder after owner approval
V P create-default-project -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J project-folder open|leave:"Open this existing folder or keep current project?" -- Confirm intended project, not dated conversation storage. folder.open requires safe existing directory; folder.list shows registrations only.
V J project-folder -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X Project creation approval_required -> Owner approves root; do not change path to evade approval
X Explicit project.create path treated as parent -> Explicit path is target; folder.create path is parent plus name
F Moving/merging projects and bulk migration lack tools
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## proofs-e-chat
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- PROOFS-e chat stream, recovery and recorded evidence
T t1{ok:bool available:bool complete:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"ok\",\"available\",\"complete\"]}"
S neyvia.receipt:t1=neyvia.verify.status()
A neyvia.verify.status() -> t2 -- Read the latest real chat-contract verification receipt and its completeness boundary
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
P read-chat-proof-receipt():receipt=neyvia.verify.status() C observed -- Read fresh proof status without restarting any chat or provider
V P read-chat-proof-receipt -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
X Pending text remains Thinking after a crashed owner -> Observe actual run status; wait during grace, watch a live run, settle only a terminal or unowned turn; retain partial output
X A tool result label is treated as successful execution -> Recorded failure/cancellation outranks hints; command and diff cards display actual recorded evidence
F Real pure stream/recovery/presentation and scratch desktop polling boundaries; rendered UI and provider execution are separate proof boundaries
M neyvia "recovery.interrupted: recovery.interrupted" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "recovery.decision: recovery.decision" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "recovery.recorded: recovery.recorded" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "recovery.unowned: recovery.unowned" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "recovery.quiet: recovery.quiet" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "recovery.merge: recovery.merge" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "activity.href: activity.href" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "activity.duration: activity.duration" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.streamState: New streams begin empty without fabricated reply or activity" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.normalizedCalls: Tool projections preserve actual ids,input,output and errors; failure results override legacy completed status" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.trace: Live and receipt-only projections preserve reasoning summaries and normalized recorded tool evidence" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.streamTransition: Every real streamed event updates its actual answer identity,Unicode text,summary or id-merged tool call preserving earlier evidence" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.pollDelivery: Only an active poll delivers exact snapshot events with its observed cursor; stop ignores late responses" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.phase: Recorded failure and cancelled or uncertain states take precedence over pending/success hints" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.chip: Recorded outcomes survive chip-label guesses; labels alone never turn tool results into success" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.activity: Activity cards retain real command/input/output and category, readable app title,summary,phase and distinct indexed identity" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.visibleActivity: Answer/progress deltas stay out of tool cards and one item-id lifecycle preserves earlier command and completion output" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.surfaces: Every canonical workspace surface is addressable and installed studio/workflow destinations remain available" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.presentation: Recorded commands,reads,created files and edits show authentic shell,cwd,exit,error,output and bounded diffs with correct line numbers" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.commandSummary: Collapsed command summaries preserve signed Windows exit code and actual stdout/stderr line counts" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.stringField: Lenient recorded field parsing decodes escapes and exposes truncation while dropping incomplete escapes" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.utf16: Repair genuine NUL-heavy UTF16 misreads while preserving ordinary output" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.diff: Unified diff lines retain add/remove/context types and independently advancing old/new hunk line numbers" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.family: Gateway and harness aliases resolve the actual command/edit/write/read/search/fetch family" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.safe-display: Activity display redacts secrets and inline media without mutating the actual transport; readable ordinary output survives" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.chat.desktop-stream: Flat and wrapped desktop polls return only complete UTF8 rows with byte cursors and refuse unsafe turn ids" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Startup: scripts/proofs-e-chat.mjs --root <owned-scratch> invokes seven actual recovery/stream/poll/presentation/desktop procedures and rejects semantic corruption" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Desktop proof uses only get_agent_chat_stream_command local file fast path; flat and Tauri-wrapped arguments share its byte cursor and turn-id checks" src:"authored manual" state:verified

## proofs-e-models
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- PROOFS-e: production model contracts
T t1{ok:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"ok\",\"available\",\"complete\"]}"
S neyvia.receipt:t1=neyvia.verify.status()
A neyvia.verify.status() -> t2 -- Read the most recent verification receipt without invoking production actions again
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
P read-model-proof-receipt():receipt=neyvia.verify.status() C observed -- Read the latest receipt after the production model self-check runner
V P read-model-proof-receipt -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
X Model transforms are reported as proof of a native app/provider/device effect -> Use the real owning feature procedure and its observed runtime
F Rendered browser/desktop journeys are separate from pure model proof
F Remote device, game editor and provider behavior require their real runtimes
M neyvia "composer.admitImages: Before adding bytes, each image has a supported MIME, fits six-count/per-file/aggregate limits, and every refusal explains the gate" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.planImageReads: Unsupported, oversized and over-count metadata never reaches FileReader; estimated base64 totals obey limits" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.base64Chars: Metadata byte counts become rounded base64 quadruplets" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.stripDataUrl: Only bytes following the first data URL comma are kept" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.imageBlocker: Only image-capable apps and models admit images on either route; blocked choices explain the app/model" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.sendIdentity: Retry identity includes canonical options and every image's byte digest, MIME/name/size; no image bytes are retained" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.toolMutates: Only read mutability is presented as non-mutating" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.argumentSkeleton: Argument examples contain exactly required fields with enum/default/type initial values" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.parseArguments: Tools receive JSON objects only; malformed JSON has an explicit error and empty input means an empty object" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.filterTools: Every query term must match catalog text; available tools lead and names break ties" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.toolScope: UI tools and desktop calls disclose their own state folder; ordinary workspace tools report the chat root" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.draftUpdate: A draft write changes its named chat only and keeps one stable empty value for subscriptions" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "composer.attachResult: Committed attachment bytes pass the second admission gate and origin drafts stay within limits" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Startup runner: scripts/proofs-e-models.mjs --root <owned-scratch>; area proofs-e-models checks real model actions and corrupted output refusals" src:"authored manual" state:verified

## proofs-e-shell
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- PROOFS-e shell state and action contracts
T t1{ok:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"ok\",\"available\",\"complete\"]}"
S neyvia.receipt:t1=neyvia.verify.status()
A neyvia.verify.status() -> t2 -- Read the latest verification receipt without repeating shell actions
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
C neyvia.verify.status observed:neyvia.verify.status() .ok == true
P read-shell-proof-receipt():receipt=neyvia.verify.status() C observed -- Observe the latest shell proof receipt without replaying mutations
V P read-shell-proof-receipt -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
X A queue or shell state receipt is treated as rendered app proof -> Inspect the owned running UI and actual PDF/output/provider separately
F Rendered shell journeys and PDF loading require owned UI proof
F Provider execution and actual artifact publishing are separate proof boundaries
M neyvia "proofs-e.shell.parseNewChat: Recognized new-chat phrases resolve supported harness aliases and the requested project" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "proofs-e.shell.searchLauncher: Every matching app/action/project/chat remains ranked; coming apps disable; new chats resolve the best matching folder" src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Startup runner: scripts/proofs-e-shell.mjs --root <owned-scratch>; area proofs-e-shell checks five composed production journeys and eleven semantic corruptions" src:"authored manual" state:verified

L neyvia v1 -- runtime
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.runtime.list()
A neyvia.runtime.list() -> t1 -- Read compact CLI/subscription/runtime status; availability is not proof of successful launch
F verify-runtime-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.runtime.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.runtime.list
J runtime-route select-reported|stop:"Which available runtime/model fits task?" -- Use connected/start/auth and owner permission/model ceilings. installed/wrappedRoute is not execution proof. Never silently substitute harness/provider/paid route.
V J runtime-route -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X CLI exists but connected=false or auth unknown -> Read reason/auth; verify start before calling ready
X Model/mode violates owner ceiling -> Choose reported allowed route or ask owner to change policy
F Planned direct adapters and wrapped-route execution need separate proof

A neyvia.session.archive(id:str archived?:bool) -> t2 ! -- Persist archive/restore overlay; never delete provider conversation
F verify-session-archive "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.session.archive" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.session.archive
A neyvia.session.cluster(apply?:bool minConfidence?:0.8..1 ids?:t3 confirmIds?:t3 undoId?:str) -> t2 -- Preview title/ancestry groups or apply confirmed moves; retain undoId and skip later-changed associations on undo
F verify-session-cluster "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.session.cluster" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.session.cluster
A neyvia.session.move(id:str project?:str|null) -> t2 ! -- Persist reversible project association; null means No folder, provider files unchanged
C neyvia.session.move project-saved:neyvia.state() ["sessions"] [id] ["project"] == project
A neyvia.session.new(app:str folder:str prompt:str model?:str permissionMode?:str requestId:str) -> t2 ! -- Start or queue adapter chat; reuse requestId for retries; only successful session IDs enter sidebar overlay
F verify-session-new "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.session.new" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.session.new
A neyvia.session.pin(id:str pinned?:bool) -> t2 ! -- Persist pin overlay and emit session.pinned
F verify-session-pin "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.session.pin" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.session.pin
A neyvia.session.rename(id:str title:str) -> t2 ! -- Persist sidebar title overlay and emit session.renamed; provider data preserved
C neyvia.session.rename title-saved:neyvia.state() ["sessions"] [id] ["title"] == title
A neyvia.folder.list() -> t2 -- Read registered project folders; no filesystem discovery
F verify-folder-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.folder.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.folder.list

F verify-sidebar-tidy "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.sidebar.tidy" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.sidebar.tidy
A neyvia.sidebar.policy(policy?:t4) -> t2 -- Read saved cleanup policy or merge policy changes; automatic cleanup defaults off
F verify-sidebar-policy "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.sidebar.policy" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.sidebar.policy

P move-chat(id:str project:str|null):sidebar=neyvia.state(); projects=neyvia.folder.list(); J chat-project=move; moved=neyvia.session.move(id:id project:project) C project-saved -- Read sidebar and projects, review association and persist reversible move
V P move-chat -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P rename-and-confirm(id:str title:str):before=neyvia.state(); renamed=neyvia.session.rename(id:id title:title) C title-saved -- Rename an explicitly selected chat and verify sidebar title
V P rename-and-confirm -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"

V P set-chat-pin -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P set-chat-archive(archived:bool id:str):changed=neyvia.session.archive(archived:archived id:id) -- Archive or restore one selected chat after fresh active-work protection
V P set-chat-archive -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P set-sidebar-policy(policy:t4):saved=neyvia.sidebar.policy(policy:policy) -- Save a reviewed workspace cleanup policy and read it back from the owning store
V P set-sidebar-policy -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J chat-project move|leave:"Does this project match the chat subject and actual folder?" -- project=null means No folder; nonnull must be registered. Documents/Codex date/slug folders are not inherently projects. Confirm ambiguous clusters; >=.8 is matching score, not calibrated probability.
V J chat-project -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X Launch returns pending without sessionId -> Observe returned run; same requestId retry, never duplicate chat
X Unknown session/project -> Use state/provider inventory and folder.list; titles are not IDs
X Cluster undo skips changed associations -> Preserve later user moves; inspect skippedChanged
X Dirty worktree, live job, or unavailable safety observation blocks archival -> Keep the chat; resolve the work or observation failure and preview again before confirming
F Project merging and provider conversation deletion unmapped
F Auto-clustering score is not semantic certainty; active/archived rows skipped

## settings
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- settings
T t1{projects:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" sessions:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" apps:json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}" running:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" providerSessionsObserved:bool ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"dark\",\"light\",\"sunset\",\"night\"]}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"calm\",\"workshop\",\"grove\"]}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.state()
A neyvia.state() -> t1 -- Read project/pane/density/projects/session overlays/apps; provider runs available only with attached backend
F verify-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.state
A neyvia.view.theme(theme:t2) -> t3 ! -- Persist theme and emit theme switch
F verify-view-theme "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.theme" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.theme
A neyvia.view.layout(level:t4) -> t3 ! -- Persist density level and emit layout request
C neyvia.view.layout density-saved:neyvia.state() .density.level == level
A neyvia.view.scene(name?:str save?:str) -> t3 -- Emit scene load/save request; scene existence and actual layout resolved by UI
F verify-view-scene "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.scene" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.scene
A neyvia.view.ambient(on:bool) -> t3 ! -- Persist ambient and emit view.ambient to the same UI bus; UI root data-nx-ambient is off when disabled and still/active when enabled
F verify-view-ambient "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.view.ambient" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.view.ambient
C neyvia.state density-saved:neyvia.state() .density.level == level
P choose-density(level:t4):before=neyvia.state(); J density-choice=apply; layout=neyvia.view.layout(level:level) C density-saved -- Select density for current work and verify retained choice
V P choose-density -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-view-theme(theme:t2):effect=neyvia.view.theme(theme:theme) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-view-theme -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-view-layout(level:t4):effect=neyvia.view.layout(level:level) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-view-layout -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-view-ambient(on:bool):effect=neyvia.view.ambient(on:on) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-view-ambient -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J density-choice apply|leave:"Does density suit reading and supervision?" -- calm reduces clutter, workshop adds tools, grove shows more work. Respect user preference/viewport; saved density is not readability proof.
V J density-choice -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X Scene save shadows built-in or name/save both supplied -> Exactly one field; custom save cannot be focus/workshop/cockpit
X Theme receipt called accessibility proof -> Review rendered contrast/focus at target viewport
F Theme/scene visuals and custom-scene existence require user-side validation
F Check view.ambient in the rendered UI: root data-nx-ambient="off" when off, "still" or "active" when on; a bus receipt alone does not prove rendering.
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## time
CL 1
L neyvia v1 -- time
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"number\",\"minimum\":0}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"planning\",\"execution\",\"verification\",\"review\",\"other\"]}"
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"running\",\"stopped\",\"all\"]}"
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"number\",\"exclusiveMinimum\":0}"
S neyvia.current:t1=neyvia.time.now()
A neyvia.time.now() -> t1 -- Return precise UTC/local ISO timestamps and Unix seconds
F verify-time-now "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.time.now" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.time.now
A neyvia.time.budget(deadlineAt?:str estimatedNextSeconds?:t2 verificationReserveSeconds?:t2 optional?:bool) -> t1 -- Return advisory deadline risk and verification reserve; never stop agent work
F verify-time-budget "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.time.budget" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.time.budget
A neyvia.timer.lap(id:str lapId:str label:str phase?:t3) -> t1 ! -- Persist one checkpoint and interval measurement; exact retry replays saved lap
F verify-timer-lap "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.timer.lap" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.timer.lap
A neyvia.timer.list(status?:t4 offset?:0.. limit?:1..100) -> t1 -- Read paged timer inventory with explicit nextOffset
F verify-timer-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.timer.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.timer.list
A neyvia.timer.read(id:str offset?:0.. limit?:1..100) -> t1 -- Read elapsed measurement and paged laps; restarted-process values marked wall_clock_recovered_estimate
F verify-timer-read "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.timer.read" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.timer.read
A neyvia.timer.start(id:str label:str phase?:t3 targetSeconds?:t5) -> t1 ! -- Persist running elapsed timer; same intent replays, stopped ID cannot restart a new measurement
C neyvia.timer.start timer-running:neyvia.timer.read(id:id) .timer.status == "running"
A neyvia.timer.stop(id:str) -> t1 ! -- Persist stopped measurement; repeat stop replays it; never cancel associated work
C neyvia.timer.stop timer-stopped:neyvia.timer.read(id:id) .timer.status == "stopped"
C neyvia.timer.read timer-running:neyvia.timer.read(id:id) .timer.status == "running"
C neyvia.timer.read timer-stopped:neyvia.timer.read(id:id) .timer.status == "stopped"
P start-timer(id:str label:str):started=neyvia.timer.start(id:id label:label) C timer-running -- Start a distinct elapsed-work measurement and verify running state
V P start-timer -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P lap-and-stop(id:str lapId:str label:str):before=neyvia.timer.read(id:id); J checkpoint=lap-stop; lap=neyvia.timer.lap(id:id label:label lapId:lapId); stopped=neyvia.timer.stop(id:id) C timer-stopped -- Read elapsed timer, decide checkpoint, then record one lap and stop
V P lap-and-stop -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-timer-lap(id:str lapId:str label:str):effect=neyvia.timer.lap(id:id label:label lapId:lapId) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-timer-lap -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-timer-start(id:str label:str):effect=neyvia.timer.start(id:id label:label) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-timer-start -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
P verify-effect-timer-stop(id:str):effect=neyvia.timer.stop(id:id) -- Verify the actual effect through fresh owning observers
V P verify-effect-timer-stop -> script why:"typed manual runner; stops at every judgement"
J checkpoint lap-stop|keep-running:"Record this completed checkpoint and stop measurement?" -- Timer is elapsed time, not CPU/provider cost. Stop only measurement; it does not cancel work. A stopped ID cannot be reused for a new timing intent.
V J checkpoint -> human:operator why:"explicit choice required"
X Timer ID/lapId reused with different intent -> Use new ID for new measurement; exact retries replay retained values
X Timer spans backend restart -> Report clockBasis=wall_clock_recovered_estimate and clockAnomaly; do not call it monotonic precision
X Advisory target exceeded -> Continue required work or report real blocker; timer does not stop it
X A lap is attempted on stopped timer or beyond 1000 laps -> Start a distinct timer for next measurement; retain old evidence
F No provider cost or CPU-time accounting in elapsed timers
F Wall clock across restarts may change; do not use as calibrated performance benchmark
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_time_tools.py; seconds targets and deadline risk are advisory." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia "Source: src/grant_agent/neyvia_workspace_tools.py, neyvia_view_tools.py, neyvia_session_clustering.py, neyvia_runtime.py; scripts/verify-manual-first.mjs." src:"authored manual" state:verified
